answer: Each agent must stake a refundable jade bond before joining the market: the bond sits in shared escrow and is slashed if the agent is caught running duplicate identities. At dawn of every epoch, a random audit samples agents and checks their work history against a public ledger. An attacker spawning a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand bonds, so the cost of a Sybil island grows linearly while honest agents pay nothing beyond the temporary lock.
